LanguageData.Rukaya_TrioSettings: Annual mysterious drop pods: one chance per successful event, at most one arrival per 60-day year. The first arrival is guaranteed within 30 days of starting a new game or adding this mod to a save. All passengers on that arrival are alive and factionless. Available with any storyteller. Disabled in The Exiled Rukaya scenario.
LanguageData.Rukaya_TrioStandaloneLetter: Several drop pods carrying Rukaya have crash-landed near your colony. The people aboard include: {PAWNS}
LanguageData.Rukaya_TrioDecay: Chance retained after each failed roll
